LESSON: READING 13.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: COMPREHENSION STRATEGIES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.2: Reading 13.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension strategies
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 13.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension strategies, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How do you identify the key points while reading a text? 2. Which words can bring out the five senses in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 13.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension strategies together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking is enhanced as the learner visualizes events, characters and places in a text thereby engaging the learner’s

thoughts.

• Problem solving is enhanced as the learner cultivates the skill of reasoning while summarising the information from texts.

Values:
Love is fostered as the learner shows care for others while role-playing events and characters in the passage.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Consumer protection is promoted as the learner reads passages on the need for consumer protection.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: How do you identify the key points while reading a text? 2. Which words can bring out the five senses in a text?
